structured.answer: Harel's fees are all about the same (0.54%–0.61%), and the track that did best is "מניות" (24.04% over 3 years), with S&P 500 next (13.7%), so that's what I'd look at. But the page opened on קופת גמל להשקעה, not my קרן השתלמות, so I didn't really see everything Harel has.
